positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Dealsplus.com is an e-commerce platform for coupons and deals.
Lead the engineering team.  
* Architected a scalable, reliable, and cost-effective website with 9 million monthly active users, companion mobile apps, and the infrastructure supporting them with the minimum resources.
* Reduced operating cost 10 fold by migrating bare metal servers in a data center to a cloud computing platform. (Kubernetes, Chef, App Engine, PubSub, GCP, Stack driver)
* Designed and developed scalable microservices. (e.g. GraphQL, Scala, PHP, NodeJS, MySQL, ElasticSearch, BigQuery, Redis etc.)
* Designed and developed a Recommendation Engine using deep learning (Keras-Tensorflow, BigQuery, Apache Airflow).

positions.title: CTO & Founder
positions.description:
Progrids is an advertising platform that matches related products to content websites. The goal of Progrids is to give Advertisers and Publishers a way to work better together in a way that is in real-time, programmatic, scalable, and profitable for everyone. 
* Built data pipeline for massive advertisement impression data from the publishers up to millions of data points a day. (Scala, NodeJS, Hadoop) 
* Analyzed impression logs, and trained the Collaborative filtering machine learning model to improve ad performance (Spark, Mahout) 
* Analyzed the publisher content with natural language processing technology for the Content-based product matching system. (Elasticsearch etc.)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer for e-commerce platforms.
Designed and implemented a marketplace platform that connects independent merchants and customers.

* Built a flexible product database and a reliable checkout process. (PHP, RabbitMQ, MySQL)
* Built a geo-location-based merchant search system consists of over 40 million local merchants. (Elasticsearch)

positions.title: System Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a protein model management.
Designed and Implemented a job scheduler of distributed protein model simulator using Condor on linux cluster.
Distributed computing, Condor project, linux cluster, protein modeling, Perl, Python.

positions.title: Core Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a digital broadcasting system prototype.
Implemented a forward error correction algorithm for mobile devices.
Forward error correction, Fountain code, Raptor code.

positions.title: Co-op project researcher
positions.description:
Implementing a wireless stream access point for IEEE 802.11
Conducted throughput and delay measurement for various IEEE 802.11 parameter configuration.  
IEEE 802.11, Linux device driver, Madwifi.

positions.title: Middle-ware developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented User-Aware news service.
Data mining, Clustering.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Performance evaluation of web application servers (Web logic, MS .net etc.) for social networking service.
Implement and test simple BBS logic on several platforms.
